title: Little Amigurumi Ball
name: Little Amigurumi Ball
subtitle: Beginner Crochet Pattern
tagline: Free crochet pattern | Beginner friendly | Printable
seoTitle: Easy Crochet Ball Pattern for Beginners (Free Amigurumi) | Crochet Tracker
description: A free, easy crochet ball pattern for beginners: a small amigurumi ball worked in a spiral with a magic ring, increases and decreases. Printable, with stitch counts for every round.
lead: The perfect first amigurumi. You'll practise the magic ring, increases and decreases, and end up with a squishy ball for a cat toy, a rattle or a pom-pom alternative.
materialsTable: Worsted or DK cotton, about 15 g
notes: Worked in a continuous spiral. Don't join rounds.
Use a stitch marker in the first stitch of each round.

rounds.text: (sc, dec) x6. Stuff the ball firmly now.
Fasten off, leaving a 15 cm tail. Thread it through the front loops of the last 6 stitches, pull tight and weave in.

variations: Want a bigger ball? Add one more increase round, e.g. (3 sc, inc) x6 for 30, and one more decrease round to match.
